contexts.text: The good into which man is initiated when an infant, is permanent... and, as it is permanent, it becomes the good of life.
Whatever does not enter through some delight... does not inhere, and so is not permanent.
The permanent worship of the Lord, and thanksgiving on account of deliverance. Signified, Explained.
To sit = to be permanent in a state.
Writings in the Heavens which are not made by hand are not permanent.
Some remain (in the World of Spirits) for weeks only; some for many years...
The visible heaven and habitable earth will both be permanent.
That the evils and falsities confirmed with man are permanent... Explained.
That he who is once converted into good and truth must persevere to the end of life. Signified.
That everything persuaded and confirmed is permanent with the man as his Own. General article. DP 317:11. DP 319.
Such as a man is when he dies, such he remains to eternity. Explained.
That meanwhile they should persevere in their truths and in their good. Signified.
Without the permanence of delight (Spirits of Hell) have no will, or sensation; thus no life.
Permanence in a state of the good of love and of faith until the visitation, Signified.
He that overcometh = him who perseveres even till death.
In the world it may be blotted out, if the man does not remain spiritual even to the end of life; but if he remains [so] it cannot. Explained.
Permanence in a state of faith from charity even to the end. Signified.
That those who persevere shall be in Divine truth in Heaven. Signified, Explained.
To write is to commit to paper that which is to be permanent, and therefore, in the spiritual sense, it = that which is to be permanent in the life of man...
That he who perseveres to the end of life shall be conjoined with Heaven where the Lord is. Signified, Explained.
To sit is a word significative of essence and of permanence in the state of the Thing and of life.
The coming forth and permanence of (these), is memory.
